claim.no_denial_inference: Any failure, deadline, setup denial, missing receipt or incomplete cleanup is inconclusive for this mechanism and proves no selected network denial. The test contains no ordinary before/after health cases because it makes no network-denial claim.
claim.not_a_transparent_adapter: The 48-byte frames encode a closed reducer operation and nonce binding; they do not transport arbitrary HTTP request bytes. The selected frontend creates its fixed request internally and checks an internal fixed response sink.
claim.prior_evidence: Old AC pipe/origin success is code/protocol evidence only. It is not LPAC evidence. Old zero-cap, registryRead, PSEC/DNS and unknown-recovery records remain unchanged.
claim.statement: A source-bound, cooperative native LPAC request generator and sink with exact empty capabilities completes one fixed nonce-bound HTTP mapping through exactly two inherited pipe endpoints and a distinct ordinary relay to one held ordinary origin.

clock_contract.causality: Private raw returns and native reports bind F/start/end to the durable pre-create pair intent. Pair start is the epoch established before creation, not a claim that native I/O started then. Persist a resume-authorized intent before ResumeThread; the new selected wrapper records its first admitted native QPC after entry and before pipe I/O, no earlier than that intent and no later than its final sample. Do not compare first native execution to the owner post-ResumeThread return timestamp, since the child can run before the owner samples that return. The LPAC observer completes before the resume intent. Monotonic native final samples must be before pairE. Old B reports retain their existing F/start/end/final shape; their pair start is not promoted into a first-I/O observation. No file-GO proof is claimed.
clock_contract.pair: Preserve the old native exact ten-second pair contract: pairS is sampled once before pair creation; pairE=pairS+10F and pairE<=Dwork. Pair creation, held admission, four AccessChecks, durable returns, parent-end closure, resumes, HTTP/pipe work and normal exits all consume that same pair interval. If this cannot fit, stop inconclusive; do not move pairS after launch or extend pairE.
clock_contract.root: One original epoch T0/F. Droot=T0+120F; ordinary worker Dworker=Droot-5F. No reset, converted wall clock or fresh local timeout domain.
clock_contract.sync_limits: Job kill/held exit is process supervision only. It is not a claim that a blocked synchronous pipe API was cancellable, no side effect occurred, or a service/broker was cancelled.
clock_contract.waits: Wait all three held processes with the original absolute cutoffs. After the two pair processes finish normally, explicitly await the held origin's final report/exit in the same pairE before generic cleanup so a healthy origin writing its report is not killed by a zero-time poll.
clock_contract.work_cutoff: Dwork=Droot-35F, preserving cleanup reserve. Origin setup/ready and all pair protocol work fit this cutoff.

evidence_contract.public: Closed safe schema. Allow mechanism_verified/network_tested (network scope ordinary-relay-to-owned-origin only), selected_ipc_observed, semantic_lpac_verified, cleanup flags and source/raw commitment hashes. Never expose PID/SID/raw handles/paths/nonces/creation time/raw QPC/private exceptions. selected_socket_api_tested stays false. API invocation/acceptance facts are not packet absence or all-network policy claims. A missing/invalid final report is explicitly unknown, not proof of network absence; retain a closed observation-status enum or equivalent nullable field rather than presenting unknown as a verified negative.
evidence_contract.status: observed only after the whole positive mechanism and cleanup closes. Otherwise inconclusive, with observed positive facts retained. Recovery required is independent and reflects unknown ownership/restoration, not an automatic consequence of any protocol failure.
evidence_contract.sticky: Independently harvest origin acceptance/request/response/EOF and relay connect facts even if another report is malformed or deadline/cleanup fails. Missing or malformed final evidence is not absence and cannot reset observed facts. Preserve raw bytes/hashes; unvalidated forensic records alone cannot qualify success.
evidence_contract.success: Require complete source/plan/device/artifact binding, genuine empty-cap held LPAC proof before resume, two exact inherited endpoints each, all parent closes, exact mapped request/response and both EOFs, independent held origin report/tuple, all three normal exit0, same-budget completion, Job empty, observer cleanup, LowMIC/ACL restoration, profile/SID cleanup and root worker/outer cleanup. No individual native report or old A/B pass is sufficient.
evidence_contract.tuple: Require relay's independent local_port==origin's peer_port, origin port==relay peer_port==ready port, both source-bound native reports claim loopback, and each report binds to its distinct held generation. This is cross-held-native tuple evidence. The unchanged B fixture does not hold the connection for an independent live kernel TCP-table snapshot; that stronger property stays false.

Unknown descendants, writes, labels, handles, allocation/creation, observer resources or close results retain the tree/profile and recovery-required state; no automatic sweep.

pipe_ownership_contract.child_checks: Each child checks both values are distinct FILE_TYPE_PIPE handles, clears HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT and reads back both flags before any protocol I/O. The selected wrapper adds readback because the old Probe only checks the SetHandleInformation return.
pipe_ownership_contract.eof: No writer duplicate may be retained in worker, origin or the wrong child. Both pipe EOF observations, frame totals and consumed close receipts are mandatory for success. Synchronous ReadFile/WriteFile can block; the original outer Job watchdog bounds process lifetime, not API cancellation.
pipe_ownership_contract.failure_boundary: Microsoft documents failed CreatePipe outputs as indeterminate. Do not blindly adopt or CloseHandle arbitrary nonzero failed-call outputs as known handles. Failed/exceptional allocation with ambiguous outputs is a separate unknown-allocation receipt and conservative recovery state; no second allocation attempt. Legacy owned_pipe currently adopts nonzero outputs in finally and cannot be copied as the new strict failure contract without resolving this boundary.
pipe_ownership_contract.objects: Two anonymous pipes; four parent handles initially. CreatePipe successful output pairs must be nonnull, distinct and nonaliased with every live owned handle. Request and response direction is fixed.
pipe_ownership_contract.parent_close: After both pair children have returned known process handles, been ledger-registered and held-admitted, close each of the four parent ends once before resuming either pair child. A close failure consumes the handle, prevents resume, and remains uncertain; do not retry it.
pipe_ownership_contract.security: Create with an explicit protected descriptor limited to creator user and SYSTEM, without a named external rendezvous or broad AAP/ARAP/everyone/package ACE. Read back the descriptor and inherit flags before use. Inheritance transfers existing handle authority; it is not a new package-SID open or an authentication proof. Do not silently add a pipe capability/ACL/label if inherited use fails.

primary_sources.supports: Inherited handles preserve the same object, value and access privileges; HANDLE_LIST can select which inherited handles a specific child receives.

Explicit application path/environment/extended startup and inheritance semantics; a successful creation return is before process initialization and does not prove later image/identity/initialization success.
Anonymous ReadFile/WriteFile pipe I/O, explicit security/inheritance, output parameters indeterminate on failure, and pipe lifetime until the last handle closes.
Pipe descriptor permissions require deliberate scope. An inherited-handle cooperative mechanism is not a hostile same-SID authentication proof.
